sources.scope: MIP*=RE; 1 versus <=1/2 entangled-value undecidability; Cqa strictly contained in Cqc; negative Connes embedding consequence. External theorem; its advertised Lean formalization was not executed locally.

sources.title: Affine structures and non-archimedean analytic spaces

sources.title: Representation Learning via Quantum Neural Tangent Kernels
sources.scope: Frozen/lazy variational dynamics, corrections and a specified hybrid large-width Gaussian regime; no universal finite-circuit QFT limit.

sources.title: Analytic theory for the dynamics of wide quantum neural networks
sources.scope: Many-qubit/many-parameter circuits and ensemble-average training behavior; width conventions differ from a fixed finite model.

sources.title: Quantum tangent kernel
sources.scope: Deep parameterized-circuit tangent-kernel regime and numerical ansatz-generated dataset; limited empirical comparison.

sources.title: Derived equivalences of gentle algebras via Fukaya categories
sources.inspected: Abstract/version page and author-hosted theorem summary
sources.scope: Homologically smooth graded gentle algebra; perfect category; surface with nonempty boundary, stops and line field. Not blanket equivalence for completed dessin lattices.

sources.title: Tropical Geometry of Deep Neural Networks
sources.scope: ReLU networks and tropical rational maps; does not make every attention mechanism an algebraic tropicalization.

sources.title: Two-dimensional topological quantum field theories and Frobenius algebras
sources.scope: Oriented finite-dimensional 2D TQFT/Frobenius equivalence; does not imply positive Hilbert/dagger/unitary structure.

sources.title: Quantum generalizations of Bell's inequality

sources.scope: Quantum Bell bounds; review supplies independent full proof of the elementary CHSH instance.

sources.title: Algebraic Topology, Chapter 1
sources.scope: Covering spaces and fundamental group. Theta voltage-tree construction and finite-support Hom example are independently proved here.
